#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>

struct State {
    bool inside = false;
    std::string current;
    int max = 0;
    int words = 0;
};

void process(State& st, char c) {
    if (c == '(') {
        st.inside = true;
        if ((int)st.current.length() > st.max) st.max = st.current.length();
        st.current.clear();
    } else if (c == ')') {
        st.inside = false;
        if (st.current.length() > 0) {
            st.words++;
            st.current.clear();
        }
    } else if (std::isalpha(c)) {
        st.current.push_back(c);
    } else if (c == '_') {
        if (st.inside) {
            if (st.current.length() > 0) {
                st.words++;
                st.current.clear();
            }
        } else {
            if ((int)st.current.length() > st.max) st.max = st.current.length();
            st.current.clear();
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    int how;
    std::cin >> how;
    std::cin.ignore();
    std::string s;
    std::getline(std::cin, s);
    State st;
    for (char c : s) {
        process(st, c);
    }
    if ((int)st.current.length() > st.max) st.max = st.current.length();
    std::cout << st.max << " " << st.words << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
